meanings.note: Russian preposition meaning 'in' that governs a specific oblique case on the following noun phrase.

examples.text: Тебя не учили во время съёмок?
examples.trans: Did they not teach you how to behave during filming?

examples.text: Подожди, ты про Вику во сне?
examples.trans: Wait, you mean Vika in your dream?

examples.text: Она позвала меня в кабинет помочь.
examples.trans: She called me into the office to help.

meanings.note: Declinable masculine noun meaning 'pocket', changing its case ending across all six Russian grammatical cases to mark its role in the clause.

examples.text: Угадай, какой палец у меня в кармане?
examples.trans: Guess which finger is in my pocket?

examples.text: Когда нет в кармане денег.
examples.trans: When there is no money in your pocket.

examples.text: Он положил ключи в карман.
examples.trans: He put the keys in his pocket.

meanings.note: Conversational Russian particle ('let's') that adds modal nuance, emphasis, or negation in spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Давай убирать!
examples.trans: Let's clean up!

examples.text: Давай, пока!
examples.trans: See you, bye!

examples.text: Аркаша, давай убирать!
examples.trans: Arkasha, let's clean up!

meanings.note: Russian preposition meaning 'without' that governs a specific oblique case on the following noun phrase.

examples.text: Только давай без вашей мужской солидарности.
examples.trans: Just spare me your male solidarity.

examples.text: Он без копии дал хорошие деньги.
examples.trans: He gave us good money for not keeping a copy.

examples.text: Дима, давай сегодня только без скандалов.
examples.trans: Dima, let's just have no scandals today.

meanings.note: Declinable masculine noun meaning 'scandal', changing its case ending across all six Russian grammatical cases to mark its role in the clause.

examples.text: Дима, давай сегодня только без скандалов.
examples.trans: Dima, let's just have no scandals today.

examples.text: В зале ресторана начался скандал.
examples.trans: A scandal began in the restaurant dining room.

examples.text: Не нужно устраивать скандал.
examples.trans: There is no need to make a scene.
